title: Public physicians' national strike, 24–26 December 2024
exclusion_reason: Opened source documents a work stoppage and announces future public demonstrations, but does not confirm a public gathering associated with the strike. The 29 December march and 30 December–5 January local demonstrations remain separate unresolved leads.

start_date.summary: The strike was scheduled for 24–26 December.

organizer.summary: Article identifies the Independent Union of Public-Sector Doctors.

demands.summary: The union cites government non-compliance with health-sector agreements and public budget/remuneration concerns.
